about_what_body.en: MTM (Media Technology Monitor) is a continuous, bilingual research initiative that tracks how Canadians use media and technology — from streaming and social platforms to devices and emerging tech — across English and French Canada. Running since 2005, MTM exists so that understanding how Canadians actually use media doesn't require guesswork: broadcasters, advertisers, educators, and policymakers all plan around the same independent numbers.

about_values_item_1_desc.en: 12,000+ Canadians surveyed twice a year — enough sample to break down by niche demographics.

about_values_item_2_desc.en: Refreshed every spring and fall, so the numbers reflect how Canadians use media right now.

about_values_item_3_desc.en: 5,000+ variables across demographics, devices, and platforms — one dataset, not a patchwork of surveys.

about_values_item_4_desc.en: The same core methodology every wave since 2005, so trend claims actually hold up.

about_timeline_item_1_body.en: MTM launches: an annual fall survey of 8,000 Canadians, gathering media and technology data by landline telephone.

about_timeline_item_2_body.en: A spring wave is added alongside the fall wave, and the annual sample grows to 12,000 Canadians — the release cadence still used today.

about_timeline_item_3_body.en: The MTM Portal launches, making data available online for the first time.

about_timeline_item_4_body.en: Cell-phone-only households are added to the sample, keeping pace with how Canadians were actually reachable by phone.

about_timeline_item_5_body.en: MTM's 10th anniversary. The interactive Trending Tool and Forecasting Tool launch, with 1,500+ data points now available.

about_timeline_item_6_body.en: MTM Jr. launches, extending coverage to Canadians aged 2–17; additional EDI questions are added to the survey.

about_timeline_item_7_body.en: MTM Newcomers launches; the sample expands to include Northern Canada and a booster sample of Indigenous respondents.

about_timeline_item_10_body.en: The YourData visualization tool launches on the Portal; over 4,000 data points are now available to users.

about_timeline_item_12_body.en: MTM Census Tool 2.0 and the MTM Chatbot launch.

about_faq_item_1_question.en: How long has MTM been collecting data?

about_faq_item_1_answer.en: Continuously since 2005 — MTM is one of Canada's longest-running trackers of media and technology behaviour.

about_faq_item_2_answer.en: Yes. Every MTM product follows a validated, peer-reviewed methodology, detailed in each product's methodology section.

about_faq_item_3_question.en: Can more than one organization use the same MTM dataset?

about_faq_item_3_answer.en: Yes. MTM is built as a shared industry reference — the same dataset is used by multiple broadcasters, advertisers, and agencies, not licensed exclusively to one company.
